value: **Involvement**: Teachers collaborated as design partners in collaborative design sessions to provide pedagogical domain expertise, define requirements, evaluate usability, and iteratively refine educational technology tools and online learning environments. **Evidence**: "Participatory methods in the learning sciences often bring in students, teachers, and parents to create research that is more relevant and ideally provides benefits to the stakeholders involved in that research (Jacobs et al 2016)."
